zh: 将类别和指标整理为矩阵。

en: Organize categories and measures into a matrix.
Arrange series with grouped_bar and apply bar_label to each bar container.
Check units, legend order and label collisions.

exercise.zh: 用三种方法在三个数据集上的同单位指标替换企鹅长度；沿用固定系列顺序，给每根柱加数值，并试一次长类别名。
exercise.en: Replace penguin lengths with a same-unit metric for three methods on three datasets. Preserve series order, label every bar, and test long category names.

zh: 每个图形标记能追溯到输入数据。
坐标、图例与标注说明单位和含义。

en: Every mark is traceable to input data.
Axes, legends and annotations explain units and meaning.
Do not compare incompatible units on one bar-height scale.

caution.zh: 不同量纲不应直接共用同一柱高尺度。

prompt.zh: 使用我提供的真实数据制作「带数值标签的分组柱图」。组间留空，组内保持稳定的系列顺序；标签贴近对应柱，图例说明系列。将类别和指标整理为矩阵。用 grouped_bar 排列系列，再对每个 bar container 添加 bar_label。检查单位、图例顺序和柱顶标签是否相互遮挡。写清字段、单位、样本筛选和统计定义；以可下载原例为代码参考。不同量纲不应直接共用同一柱高尺度。缺少输入时明确指出，不编造数据或结果。

Organize categories and measures into a matrix. Arrange series with grouped_bar and apply bar_label to each bar container. Check units, legend order and label collisions. State fields, units, sample selection and statistical definitions, using the downloadable original example as a code reference. Do not compare incompatible units on one bar-height scale. Identify missing inputs instead of inventing data or results.
